name: emma-annotations
comment: The Prism's reader of what its person says to it (app/src/PrismEmma.lex.tex), held to W3C EMMA 1.0. Every prompt or gesture is one EMMA document; the request 'check' and a line end, then a document, answers 'malformed' when it is not well-formed namespace-aware XML, else 'conforms' or 'violates' with the Implementation Report Plan assertions it breaks, then ';' and the assertions whose features it shows. The second set of the emma guest's acceptance vectors: the documents of sections 4.2 to Appendix C of the Recommendation app/specs/emma/spec.json pins, listed and carried the same way.

     http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/REC-emma-20090210/emma.xsd"

    <destination emma:tokens="to London">London</destination>
    <date emma:tokens="tomorrow">20030315</date>

</emma:emma>
